name: Morgan Stern
summary: In Theramore, Angus Stern waits for word from Morgan Stern, who is gathering recipes for a new menu.

sections.title: A Bayou Menu
sections.body: Angus Stern wants customers at the Blue Recluse to taste rural dishes in the bayou style. He sent his nephew Morgan to Theramore, the city beside Dustwallow Marsh, to gather recipes from the locals. The journey is too long for Angus, so he asks you, a young traveler, to speak with Morgan.

sections.title: What Morgan Has to Say
sections.body: In Theramore, Morgan Stern says his search for recipes has brought him a few leads. He needs help following them, and the work calls for someone willing to get their feet wet.

faq.answer: Morgan Stern is Angus Stern's nephew. Angus sent him to Theramore to gather recipes from the locals.

faq.q: Why does Angus Stern want to reach Morgan?
faq.answer: Angus is developing a new menu of rural dishes with a bayou theme for the Blue Recluse. He wants to hear what Morgan has found so far.

faq.q: Where can Morgan Stern be found?
faq.answer: Morgan is in Theramore, the city beside Dustwallow Marsh.
